title: TransferFailed
description: Published by transfer-service (SAGA orchestrator, ADR-0003) on the `finpay.transfer` topic when a transfer saga fails and compensation is triggered. Partitioned by transferId.

eventId.description: Globally unique event identifier. Consumers MUST deduplicate on this field (outbox redelivery / at-least-once semantics).

eventType.description: Fixed event type; matches the schema name and the stream-filterable discriminator.

occurredAt.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp when the event occurred.

version.description: Major schema version of this event. Additive changes stay at the same major; breaking changes require a new vN/ schema.

partitionKey.description: Kafka partition key; equals the business key transferId for saga ordering.

amount.description: Transfer amount as a decimal string (no floating point).

currency.description: ISO-4217 currency code of the transfer.

status.description: Transfer state machine status on failure.

sagaStep.description: The saga step at which the transfer failed.

failureReason.description: Human-readable failure cause; useful for observability and support.
